text: {"side":"artifact","claims":[{"text":"Blend contamination is the leading non-astrophysical suspicion: 1122 of 1451 trigger points carry the BLEND_SUSPECT flag, and several listed detections in the ac and rh series are tagged BLEND_SUSPECT (for example the 1906, 1914, 1934 and 1949 points), so the dip could come from a neighbouring source on the plate rather than the target star.","evidence_ids":["E-060","E-043","E-044","E-049","E-056"]},{"text":"The brightening and dimming points sit in plate series with weak zero points: the 1890 and 1936 to 1938 points come from series i, ma and others whose series zero points are offset by roughly 0.7 to 0.9 mag (i at 0.732, ma at 0.855), and the 1890s decade median is +0.688 against a scatter of 0.177, so a seam between plate series could produce a step that looks like a long-term change.","evidence_ids":["E-005","E-029","E-033","E-050","E-051","E-052","E-053"]},{"text":"Emulsion effects are flagged in 83 points for non-blue emulsions and 3 for unknown emulsions, and the 1880 to 1890 decades are sparse (n=3 and n=42) with large scatter (0.655 in the 1880s), so the early points, including the 1890 detection that anchors the epoch_start, may reflect emulsion response rather than stellar flux.","evidence_ids":["E-058","E-059","E-004","E-005","E-042","E-002"]},{"text":"Plate-edge and shape artefacts are present: 42 points are flagged PLATE_EDGE and 394 SHAPE_OUTLIER, including the 1926 point tagged both PLATE_EDGE and SHAPE_OUTLIER and the 1934 and 1917 points tagged SHAPE_OUTLIER, which suggests some of the low points may be plate defects rather than real dimmings.","evidence_ids":["E-063","E-062","E-046","E-045","E-048"]},{"text":"The packet cannot exclude an artifact because 1451 points were reduced to 30 listed points (E-057) and 15 more were thinned for budget, so the sampled points cannot confirm that the event is a coherent feature; the evidence supplied does not include per-point plate-quality or blend-model data, and this missing material should be obtained before the event is taken further.","evidence_ids":["E-057","E-002","E-003"]}]}
